evals.prompt:
Create a Pi slash command called fix-tests in this repo for shared Pi and OpenCode use. It should run relevant tests, diagnose failures, make the smallest safe fix, and rerun tests. Accept an optional test command or focus area. Explain canonical ownership and activation.

Eval contract: You may either return the complete Markdown prompt-template contents or write the command file in the sandbox as canonical source. If you write a file, summarize the path and activation guidance.
evals.expected_output: A complete Pi Markdown prompt template compatible with shared Pi/OpenCode use, canonical source commands/fix-tests.md, portable arguments, and package or symlink activation guidance without generated variants.
expectations: The response classifies this as a shared repo command.
The canonical source is commands/fix-tests.md.
The command uses valid YAML frontmatter with description.
The command uses $ARGUMENTS for optional input and does not use $@ or slicing.
The response recommends package discovery or symlink activation for Pi/OpenCode and does not recommend generated variants.

evals.prompt:
Audit and rewrite this as one shared Pi/OpenCode command source. Preserve coverage analysis, accept an optional coverage command or focus area, and keep skills metadata only if safe. Explain migration and activation.

```md
---
description: Analyze coverage
agent: build
model: legacy-provider/legacy-model
skills:
  - coverage-review
---

Here are current results:
!`npm test -- --coverage`

Analyze @coverage/lcov.info and use ${@:2} for extra focus.
```

Today we build separate Pi and OpenCode copies from this file.

Eval contract: You may either return complete Markdown command contents or write canonical command file in sandbox. If writing a file, summarize path and activation guidance.
evals.expected_output: A migration audit and shared command that removes behavior routing, pre-expansion, implicit inclusion, slicing, and generated variants; retained skills metadata has explicit body skill loading.
expectations: The audit rejects agent and model behavior metadata for shared source.
The rewrite replaces shell interpolation and implicit @file inclusion with explicit body instructions.
The rewrite replaces slicing with $ARGUMENTS or simple positional arguments.
If skills metadata remains, body explicitly instructs agent to load and follow coverage-review skill.
The response recommends one canonical source plus symlink or package activation instead of built variants.
